questions.q: Which register holds the address of the next instruction to be fetched?
questions.why: The PC holds the address of the next instruction. The CIR holds the current one.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the control unit?
options: To decode instructions and send control signals to other parts
To hold the results of calculations
questions.why: The control unit decodes instructions and coordinates the other parts. The ALU does calculations and logic.

options: The controller in a microwave oven
A games console that runs many programs
questions.why: An embedded system is built into a device to do one dedicated task.

questions.q: Explain how a larger cache can improve the performance of a CPU.
questions.model: Cache is much faster than RAM and is next to the CPU. A larger cache can hold more frequently used instructions and data, so the CPU waits less for data from RAM.
points: cache is faster than RAM / close to the CPU
stores more frequently used instructions or data so fewer slower trips to RAM
